correctness.rationale: For orientation jumps j->j+1,j-1,j+2 at rates a,b,h and a+b=M>0, exact 4x4 tilted characteristic polynomial is λ(λ+2M)[(λ+L)^2+Ω^2]-k²v²(λ+M)(λ+L)+k⁴u²w² with L=M+2h,Ω=a-b. A simple principal eigenvalue near k=0 yields κ2/t=v²L/Q and κ4/t=-3v⁴[F+Q²sin²(2θ)]/(M Q³), Q=L²+Ω², F=L[(2M-L)L²-(L+2M)Ω²]. The inequality F+Q²>0 proves strictly negative diagonal rate. Algebra reduces the axial sign to χ² > (1+2q)²(1-2q)/(3+2q) for q<1/2, with q=h/M, χ=Ω/M; differentiation yields its unique maximum q*=sqrt(5)/2-1 and the positive/negative/positive reversal witness at χ²=7/20, q=0,1/8,1/2. Independent symbolic determinant and fourth-order cumulant coefficient comparisons returned exact difference zero. Finite-state spectral gap (including a=0 or b=0) justifies cumulant rate limits; not a claim about finite-time signs.
